summary: Use the notes you chose to share with agents: list, search, read, create, update and append. Only notes with the agent switch turned on can be read or changed. Nothing is deleted.

tools.name: tool_notes_listNotes
tools.purpose: List the shared notes, optionally one tag.

tools.name: tool_notes_searchNotes
tools.purpose: Search the titles and text of the shared notes.

tools.name: tool_notes_readNote
tools.purpose: Read one shared note in full.

tools.name: tool_notes_createNote
tools.purpose: Create a note (shared with agents, marked as written by an agent).

tools.name: tool_notes_updateNote
tools.purpose: Replace the title, text or tags of a shared note.

tools.name: tool_notes_appendToNote
tools.purpose: Add text to the end of a shared note; list items it already has are left out and counted.

params.name: note_id
params.description: The note's id, from the list or a search.

params.name: title
params.description: A new title; empty keeps the current one.

params.name: body
params.description: The new full text; empty keeps the current text.

params.name: tags
params.description: The new full tag list; empty keeps the current tags.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to add after the current text. List items already in the note are left out; other lines are always kept.

workflow.explanation: See which notes are shared, or filter by tag.
Read the notes that matter, by id.
Save something as a new note.
Add to a shared note without losing its text (or update it to rewrite it).
